A strange element found in the mantle of Czechoslowakia. Discovered in 1976 by two neighbors, it has very reactive properties and as such is a great [[RBMK]] fuel.
When refining [[natural concrete|Natural Concrete]], trace amounts of it can be obtained in a diffused form. To remove the mixed-in cement, the diffused buurmium must be processed in the RBMK and subsequently processed in a SILEX, or alternatively, if the fuel is depleted enough, processed in the PUREX using [[buurmic acid|Buurmic Acid]].
